decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's coolant management portfolio and supports demand for high-pressure machining.
The cleaning centrifuge strengthens the firm's filtration and sustainability offer and complements its installed systems.
The nozzle line is a low-cost accessory range that cross-sells with pumps and boosters, so keeping it costs little.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business.
Magnetic belt conveyors fill a standard need in the chip conveyor range for metalworking customers.
Hinged belt conveyors are among the most widely used conveyor types and central to the firm's established offer.
